labels: enhancement

## Problem
No authentication or user roles exist. Anyone can sign up/unregister for activities.

## Solution
- Add login/logout for admin, counsellor, and student
- Implement session management and access control
- Restrict sensitive actions to appropriate roles

## Acceptance Criteria
- Only authenticated users can perform restricted actions
- Role-based dashboards and permissions
